name: Spear Urchin Venom
body:
ABOUT

Spear urchin venom causes horrific pain that weakens the muscles and causes intense nausea. The save DC is Constitution-based.

DETAILS

Type poison (injury); Save Fortitude DC 16; Frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; Cure 1 save

EFFECT

1d2 Str and nauseated for 1 round
